claim_boundary: Historical Th-232 events directly select the deployment threshold; locked test and Eu-152 remain unopened and unused.

not retained in the audited isolated-anchor set
retention-only; no supported higher-energy Compton-background reference

optimization.no_brainer_definition: Highest geometric-mean P/B threshold with pooled net counts across all ten usable peaks retained at >=99%; this is not a per-peak >=99% constraint.
optimization.objective: normalized Pareto knee between geometric mean P/B improvement and minimum usable-peak retention
optimization.sweet_spot_definition: From no cut through the maximum reliable P/B threshold, normalize attained P/B gain and minimum-retention loss to [0,1]; select the threshold maximizing gain_fraction - retention_loss_fraction.
